metadata.title: Retro Pop Portrait with Ultra-Bold Header

retrievalProfile.description: A centered male portrait featuring a wide-brimmed fedora and a top-aligned, ultra-heavy geometric display font.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a man with feathered hair wearing a light-colored fedora and dark blazer, set against a soft-focus, desaturated background with a prominent, heavy-weight title spanning the top edge.
coreVisualRelationships: The hat brim creates a diagonal line that frames the upper face.
The ultra-bold text acts as a structural cap to the entire composition.
The dark blazer provides a heavy base that anchors the lighter skin tones and white shirt.
Soft, diffused lighting minimizes harsh shadows on the face.
coreInvariants: Centered subject with direct eye contact

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium close-up, occupying approximately 80% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes of the subject, framed by the shadow of the hat.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the heavy top text down to the face, then following the diagonal of the hat brim.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal, primarily in the upper corners and the desaturated background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted, desaturated blues and greys in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black in the blazer and hat band.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and golden hair highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white hat/shirt and black blazer.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or highly saturated modern colors

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with minimal to no counter space
Square or slightly rounded outer corners
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' and 'U' should appear as solid blocks with tiny interior apertures
The 'A' has a very high, small horizontal bar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for all text elements to maintain blocky impact.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight.
Matches the rounded-block feel of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus 1970s style portrait of a man with feathered brown hair wearing a white fedora with a black band and a black blazer over a white shirt. The background should be a blurry, desaturated blue-grey studio backdrop.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of ultra-bold, uppercase geometric sans-serif text across the very top of the image in a muted blue-grey color.

verificationChecks: Is the text at the very top edge?
Is the font weight 'Ultra-Black' with almost no counter space?
Is the image texture slightly grainy and soft-focus?

adjustableVariables: Text color (matching background vs. high contrast)
mustRedesign: Modern digital sharpness must be replaced with film-like softness
Thin typography must be replaced with ultra-heavy blocks

avoid: Modern sans-serifs like Helvetica or Arial

postGenerationChecks: Text is centered and spans the width of the image.
Typography is the most dominant graphic element.
Overall mood is nostalgic and pop-oriented.
